premiumPage.title: Two Wiggling Shadows
premiumPage.markdown: In the lantern glow, Rabbit made a rabbit shadow with his paws. Its ears wiggled fast on the grass. He slowed them so Wise Turtle could join in. Turtle shaped a steady little shell beside Rabbit’s paws. The two shadows met. The neighbors laughed, and Rabbit kept the shadow game slow enough for everyone to watch.
premiumPage.summary: Rabbit slows his playful shadow so Turtle can add a turtle shape, making the neighbors laugh.

quickPage.title: Back to Its Post
quickPage.markdown: From the near bank, Rabbit and Wise Turtle carried the bridge lantern to the bridge post and set it upright. Its warm light shone over the water. The friends stood beside the bridge, ready to fix the other markers.
quickPage.summary: Together, the friends carry the bridge lantern to its post and set it upright.
